searchText: "any of the three parties were to make the contract public": by that you mean someone post the code bytecode on-chain in a txn? (e.g: as calldata or blob?) Posts it anywhere that someone other than Alice, Bob, or Carol can see it. This could include on-chain, or off-chain. The on-chain commitment is the root of that merkle tree. If Bob publishes the code on-chain, then Alice or Carol can generate a merkle proof that proves Bob was part of the deal. And the fact that the on-chain txn has his signature (of the code) makes him responsible for slashing? Naive-ish solution since why on earth Alice, Bob or Carol would post on-chain a signed transaction with the bytecode. I'd expect you're looking for a way for each of them to have a unique representation of the contract, such that if that is leaked it can uniquely identify "which of them" made the leak? Yes. Cool yeah, that's interesting The goal is to make it so you can identify *who* leaked the contract.
